Sets everything that a scene holds, at once or over a fade time. What the scene does not hold is left alone, so scenes can be applied on top of each other. This is a BlitzLLVM extension.

```blitzbasic
ApplyAudioScene paused, 300
```
@param scene  A scene from [CreateAudioScene](CreateAudioScene). Anything else is a runtime error.
@param fade_ms  How many milliseconds it takes to get to the values. `0` (the default) sets them at once. Below 0 is a runtime error.
@gap A value that is still fading starts from where it is, as with the commands that set it, and they keep working next to scenes.
